questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying CSS Layout Fundamentals?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
questions.answer_key: one utility expresses one CSS concern or a closely related behavior
questions.explanation: CSS Layout Fundamentals is best understood through the syllabus topics: Normal document flow, Block and inline elements, Flexbox fundamentals. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with css layout fundamentals?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: combine meaningful utilities in markup and verify browser styles
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Normal document flow, Block and inline elements, Flexbox fundamentals, CSS Grid fundamentals.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying css layout fundamentals?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: visual styling does not replace semantic HTML or actual interactive behavior
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
